name: G-code Explorer
author: Stefan
description: G-code reference, line explainer, and toolpath navigator in one. Type ?keyword in the Console to look up any G/M-code or grblHAL setting, ??<line> to explain a line word by word, browse the docs and NC manual, or open the Navigator to snap to G-code lines on a 2D map, jog the machine, trace the cut outline, and unwrap 4th-axis jobs.
